name: Paludal-Menhir
description: A single unbroken ocean swallows the horizon, its color shifting from wine-dark deeps to bright shelf-teal. The only interruptions are a binary sunset, breaking the swell in a ragged arc.

In the calm seasons the world feels almost kind, which veterans say is exactly when it takes the careless. The only confirmed life is microbial, a chemosynthetic film that glows faintly where the ground weeps warmth.

The colonists of the derelict space station in orbit kept meticulous logs right up to the final entry, which is a shopping list. Rescue charters still quote the coordinates, and still decline the contract.
Archaeologists and weapons engineers circle the same sites, quoting each other's permits with disgust. The ruins tolerate both, so far.
